reason: A real Windows-only base-owned WP0 defect was reproduced on the exact trusted main authorization base while completing Learned Policy PR #379. shared/release/implementationBranchPolicy.js selects npm.cmd on win32 and passes it directly to child_process.execFileSync. On the user's Windows Node runtime that invocation fails before npm starts with EINVAL (-4071), causing the delegated npm-lock topology validator to reject three positive fixtures. The same three positive fixtures fail unchanged on trusted main c5b7d23dcd6a7aafef6f1b8749369ab008606c8b, proving this is not introduced by Learned Policy. The repair must fix the existing generic trusted npm invocation seam at source; no product exception, test weakening, shell bypass, dependency addition or #379 scope expansion is permitted.

Unix direct executable invocation remains direct. No untrusted command interpolation is permitted.
